events.title: PUCKVPUCK is in Steam Next Fest - the free demo is live
events.summary: PUCKVPUCK is a couch game for up to 8 players. Everyone is a puck: you bump, boost and slam your way through SOCCER, DODGEBALL and a top-down SHOOTER, on one screen with pads and keyboards, or online with friends. WHAT'S IN THE DEMO SOCCER on U-SHAPE, FIGURE-8, S-SHAPE and PRISM DODGEBALL on ARENA: catch it and it's yours to throw SHOOTER on all four worlds (WILD WEST, PAINTBALL, CYBERPUNK and LASER TAG) with DEATHMATCH, GUN GAME, KING, INFECTION, STACKED and SOCCER WITH GUNS CPU opponents on EA

events.title: Update 0.4 – NEW WORLDS: four new shooter maps, an event horizon and emotes
events.summary: Every mode just moved house. SOCCER plays on real grass, DODGEBALL moved into a gym, a boxing hall and a summer fair, and SHOOTER threw out its seven old maps for four new ones, each with a trick. Oh, and the black hole has an event horizon now. Nothing gets out. NEW LOOKS SOCCER plays on a real grass pitch. DODGEBALL plays in a gym, a boxing hall (COURT) and a summer fair (CAROUSEL). PINBALL soccer has new pop bumpers. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46263488/66db32486b6e703b208755973767b2161343a89b.jpg SHO

events.title: Update 0.3.5 — Deaths that tell you what got you
events.summary: In the SHOOTER modes, how you die now depends on what killed you. New death animations KNIFE → HELL. The floor cracks, breaks open into a fiery pit, and you drop in. (In INFECTION, every stab does it.) SNIPER / RAILGUN → HEAVEN. Your body stays on the floor, gone grey, and your soul flies up with wings and a halo. ROCKETS, GRENADES, the AIRSTRIKE → LAUNCHED. events.title: Update 0.3.4 — STACKED, Black Hole & six new worlds
events.summary: STACKED — a roguelike SHOOTER mode Five rounds of free-for-all with respawns. After each of the first four rounds, everyone drafts a power-up card — the round's last place picks first, and the winner gets what's left. The cards stack, so by the last round you're holding four. events.title: Update 0.2.1 — The Redesign: the whole game, redrawn
events.summary: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46263488/5b900caa83ebcc7c52de3262ccdbceb1c82ae666.jpg Every screen and every arena in PUCKVPUCK has been redrawn. The redesign is visual — puck speeds, collisions, rules and the netcode are unchanged, so everything you have learned still works. The few gameplay changes that did go in are listed at the bottom, each one on its own line. Title and menus A new opening screen. Two team pucks face each other over a lit court, under a bigger PUCK V PUCK wordmark and one clear PRESS A

events.title: Update: 4K menus, the music stops stopping, and the dodgeball ball finds you
events.summary: Readability Menus, pause menu and HUD now scale with your display. Every label was written in fixed pixels, so on a 4K screen the text rendered at literally half the size it should. A player on a 4K panel told us he simply could not read the setup screens. The whole UI now scales with screen height — the lobby, CHALLENGES, PROFILES, HOW TO PLAY, the pause menu, the scoreboard and the game-over screen.
